sections.description:
Pretpot Massive Addons Kit for Elementor is a powerful WordPress plugin that extends the Elementor page builder with the largest collection of widgets available.

Elementor itself offers 32 basic free widgets. When you add our 45+ free widgets, you get 75+ free widgets in total – more than any other Elementor addon plugin. And if you need even more power, our Premium version unlocks 165+ additional widgets.

🔥 Why Choose Pretpot Massive Addons Kit?

  • More widgets than any competitor – 45+ FREE + 165+ PREMIUM = 210+ total widgets
  • Latest animations – Scroll reveal, liquid glass, text distortion, 3D carousels, and more
  • Lightweight & fast – Optimized code that doesn’t slow your site
  • GDPR compliant – Built-in cookie consent widget
  • Header & Footer builder – Create global templates to use accross your Elementor website

sections.installation:
1. Install and activate the free Elementor plugin
  2. Upload pretpot-massive-addons-kit-for-elementor to /wp-content/plugins/, or install via the WordPress plugin repository
  3. Activate Pretpot Massive Addons Kit for Elementor
  4. Go to Pretpot Massive Addons in your WP Admin to enable widgets
  5. Start building in Elementor – our widgets are under the “Pretpot Massive Addons Kit” category
sections.faq:
Is Elementor required?

Yes. This is an addon for the Elementor page builder. It will not work without it.

Does this work with Elementor Pro?

Absolutely. It works seamlessly with both the free version of Elementor and Elementor Pro.

How many free widgets does Elementor have?

Elementor itself offers 32 basic free widgets. When you add our 45+ free widgets, you get approximately 75+ free widgets in total – more than any other Elementor addon plugin.

How many widgets are in the Premium version?

Our Premium version adds 165+ additional widgets, bringing our total to over 210 widgets – the largest collection available for Elementor.

Is WooCommerce required?

Only for widgets that display products (e.g., Add to Cart, Product Grid). All other widgets work fine without WooCommerce.

How do I get support?

For free support, please use our support channel below. For Premium support, use the VIP link.
